description:
Brad Pitt is pushed into the wild in Heart of the Beast, a brutal new survival thriller from director David Ayer.

After a devastating plane crash, former Special Forces officer James Belmont and his loyal combat dog Odin are stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Hunted by the elements, cut off from civilization, and forced to survive against impossible odds, the two must rely on instinct, loyalty, and the unbreakable bond between man and dog to make it out alive.

Starring Brad Pitt, J.K. Simmons, and Anna Lambe, Heart of the Beast delivers a tense action thriller built around survival, sacrifice, brutal wilderness danger, and one man’s fight to protect his closest companion. The film is directed by David Ayer and is set to hit theaters on September 25, 2026.
